source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: Where to Find Mandate Encampment Outer Gate Key
source_excerpt:
After reaching the Village of Lu in Phantom Blade Zero , Soul identifies two paths in a cutscene. The left leads into the Village, while the right takes you toward Mandate Encampment. However, the Outer Gate is locked, and its key cannot be found in this region. You will need to progress to Pangzhen to find it, and this guide covers exactly where to look.
Where to Find the Mandate Encampment Outer Gate Key in Phantom Blade Zero
Image via GameRant | Sources: S-GAME
After discovering that the Mandate Encampment entrance is locked, you will need to progress through the main story , defeat the final boss of Village of Lu, and complete the region. You will then make your way to Pangzhen, the largest region in the game. Reaching the key can take several hours, especially if you plan to collect all the collectibles in every area.
Progress through Pangzhen, making your way past the Tavern. After some time, you will reach the Pond of Fading Song Bell, which is located just before the Gu Wanyue boss fight.
Gu Wanyue is not one of the more challenging bosses in the game , but there are a couple of attacks you should watch out for. The first is a projectile that you need to parry so that it hits the boss. The other is a Red Flash grab, which you need to be ready to dodge.
Once you defeat the boss, you will receive a fragment of a Soul Tempering material. You can then descend into the well by interacting with the prompt.
At the bottom of the well, make your way up until you reach a room containing Puppets and other enemies. You will also spot a glowing item in the middle of the room. Deal with the enemies and pick up the item to obtain the Mandate Encampment Outer Gate Key.
Now that you have the key, you can either continue exploring Pangzhen, as I did, or return to Mandate Encampment and focus on completing that area. Mandate Encampment is one of the shorter areas in the game, with relatively few collectibles compared to Pangzhen.
Although Mandate Encampment is entirely optional, it contains several important quests that can heavily influence the game's ending.
